Task.title: Task
Task.description: A cloud-synced task item belonging to a specific user, supporting priorities, subtasks, tags, workspace grouping, device sync attribution, and scheduled notification/pop-up/call alerts.

notes.description: Detailed notes or description for the task (0 to 2000 characters).

completed.description: Whether the task is marked as completed.

workspaceName.description: Name of the workspace/category this task belongs to (1 to 50 characters).

dueDateMillis.description: Due date in epoch milliseconds, or 0 if no due date is set.

reminderTimeMillis.description: Scheduled notification/alert time in epoch milliseconds, or 0 if no reminder is scheduled.

alertMode.description: How the scheduled reminder should alert the user (system notification, pop-up dialog, or incoming AI call).

subtasks.description: Bounded list of up to 20 subtask strings formatted as '0|Title' or '1|Title'.

tags.description: Bounded list of up to 10 tag strings.

pinned.description: Whether the task is pinned to the top of the workspace.

deviceName.description: Name/model of the device that last synced this task (1 to 100 characters).

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner of this task.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: A user-defined project workspace or category synced across devices.

name.description: Display name of the workspace (1 to 50 characters).

colorHex.description: Hex color code for the workspace badge (e.g. #6366F1).

iconName.description: Identifier of the workspace icon (1 to 40 characters).

userId.description: UID of the authenticated owner of this workspace.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the workspace was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).
